This requires filtering by geographic region (Thessaly), land cover type (lakes), and time (week 12 of 2020). To identify "lakes", we need to join with landcover_type where level3_label contains 'lakes' or similar (e.g., 'Inland marshes' may be proxy, but 'Water bodies' is level1). However, landcover_upscaled contains land cover ranks linked to coordinates, but lacks direct labels — so we must join landcover_upscaled with landcover_type via level3_code. Time filtering requires extracting week from meteo_tmean.time. The region "Thessaly" is not directly in the schema, so we must infer it via approximate latitude/longitude bounds (Thessaly is in central Greece, approx. 39°N–40°N, 21°E–23°E).
